children: AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo said they received European Union approval for a drug combination that includes their Enhertu medicine as a front-line treatment for a type of advanced breast cancer.

The drugmakers said Tuesday that the EU authorization for Enhertu in combination with Roche Holding's Perjeta followed a positive opinion from a European Medicines Agency committee. The approval was based on the results of a late-stage clinical trial that showed the combination reduced the risk of disease progression or death compared with the standard-of-care therapy, they added.

This marks the first new treatment regimen in the EU for a type of metastatic breast cancer known as HER2-positive in more than a decade, and the second new indication for Enhertu in the EU in two months, the companies said.

AstraZeneca separately said a late-stage trial in China evaluating its Tagrisso drug in combination with Orpathys--which the U.K. drugmaker is developing jointly with Hutchmed--showed an improvement in progression-free survival compared with Tagrisso alone for a type of lung cancer.

title: AstraZeneca, Daiichi Sankyo Get New EU Approval for Breast Cancer Drug
